senses.gloss: ch. samecombing; ג׳ דסרבלא the removal of the woolly surface of a thick cloth.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 99a">B. Kam. 99ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 112a">B. Mets. 112ᵃ</cite>.—
<cite ref="Moed Katan 23a">M. Kat. 23ᵃ</cite> went out <he>בג׳ דס׳</he> (Ms. M. 2 <he>בגררא</he>) in a fresh scraped and smoothed cloak.

<cite ref="Shabbat 134a:12">Sabb. 134ᵃ</cite> <he>דילמא מידביק ג׳ מיניה</he> (Var. <he>מדביקא גרדתא</he>, v. Rashi a. l.) lest a thread of it stick to the membrum.—Pl. <cite ref="C00195"><he>גַּרְדַּיָּא</he></cite>, <cite ref="C01277"><he>גַּרְדֵּי</he></cite>, <cite ref="C01276"><he>גַּרְדִּין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 15:38">Targ. Y. Num. XV, 38</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Menachot 42b">Men. 42ᵇ</cite>).—
<cite ref="Bekhorot 8b:17">Bekh. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>כרוכו לי ג׳ מיניה וכ׳</he> twist for me threads pulled out of it, and I will sew it.
Men. 31ᵇ. [גַּרְדָּא or גְּרָדָא scraping, v. גִּירְדָּא.—גְּרָדָא cud, v. גְּרָרָא I.]
